column1: # USNO api/celnav (https://aa.usno.navy.mil/api/celnav?date=D&time=T&coords=LAT,LON), the Sun's almanac_data (dec, gha, hc = geocentric altitude, zn = azimuth, degrees), fetched 18 October 2026; times are UT.
# USNO leaves the Sun out of the answer when it is far below the horizon, and takes years 1800 to 2050 only.
